opportunities.title: 1,789 BTC and Counting: What the Coldcard Hack Says About Self-Custody Theater
opportunities.why_now: Galaxy just quantified a nine-figure Coldcard compromise with 87% of stolen funds still sitting untouched, which is a security post-mortem tailor-made for this beat.
opportunities.angle: Deep-dive incident breakdown: how the exploit worked, why 'not your keys not your coins' didn't save anyone here, and what the unmoved 87% tells you about the attacker's endgame (or law enforcement's leverage).

opportunities.title: Term Finance's $8.5M Governance Exploit Is the DeFi Bug That Never Stops Happening
opportunities.why_now: Another vault governance exploit landed within 24 hours of the Coldcard news, reinforcing a pattern the channel's audience already expects.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece: catalog the governance-exploit playbook across 2026 incidents and argue why 'audited' protocols keep falling to the same vector.

opportunities.title: The Sandbox Bridge Exploit: 'Contained' Is Doing a Lot of Work in That Headline
opportunities.why_now: A cross-chain bridge just minted unbacked SAND across two chains and the project is already spinning it as handled, a classic setup for skeptical scrutiny.
opportunities.angle: Skeptical breakdown of the incident response language versus what actually got fixed, plus what 'contained' means for holders who bought the unbacked tokens before detection.

opportunities.title: 280 Years for $24M: The Math on Crypto Fraud Sentencing Finally Bites
opportunities.why_now: A Las Vegas AI-mining Ponzi operator just got a sentence recommendation that dwarfs the size of the fraud, a rare case where consequences actually scale with the beat's 'this is how it ends' thesis.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on sentencing math in crypto fraud cases, why this one is an outlier, and what it signals for the current wave of AI-washed investment scams still running.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin Just Ripped 25% in a Week While Three Hacks Landed — Nobody Noticed
opportunities.why_now: The same 72 hours that produced an $80K breakout and a short squeeze also produced a nine-figure hardware wallet hack, an $8.5M DeFi exploit, and a bridge mint exploit — a perfect 'priced in' juxtaposition piece.
opportunities.angle: Contrast format: split-screen the euphoria headlines against the security incident log from the same week, arguing that rallies don't pause the threat model.
